messages:
mike-dev: quick check — we have a customer repro failing in canary, want to capture the full request/response bodies for one hour to debug. Any objections?

maria-security: prefer not to capture full prompts or auth tokens. what's the minimal set you need? :eyes:

mike-dev: mostly headers + body for a single request pattern. the body contains a user message + metadata. we need it to reproduce model misbehavior.

kate-sre: +1 to narrow scope. can you paste an example request (sanitized) so we can suggest fields to redact?

mike-dev: sure — example:```POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Request-ID: 1234
X-User-Token: 6f3a...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "input": "Customer says: \"My credit card was charged twice\"",
  "context": { "email": "user@example.com", "account_id": "acct_98765" }
}```

maria-security: thanks. do NOT log Authorization or X-User-Token. For prompts: hash the prompt text (sha256) and store the hash + length instead of cleartext. Hash should be salted with per-org salt stored in KMS.

adele-eng: can we redact email and account_id? we need to link back to a session id for support.

maria-security: keep X-Request-ID and session id only. email/account_id must be redacted or pseudonymized (hmac with org salt). No raw PII.

mike-dev: ok — so plan: temporary flag to capture one request pattern for 1 hour, log headers except auth tokens, replace prompt with `sha256(salt + prompt)`, and hmac(email) for lookup. request id retained.

kate-sre: from infra side we can enable a short-lived debug route that streams to a restricted S3 bucket with SSE-KMS. Access control will be through support-sre IAM role and we'll add CloudTrail entry.

maria-security: that sounds acceptable if: 1) salt is from KMS 2) logs are set to auto-delete after 7d (or sooner) 3) we create a ticket with justification and list of people needing access 4) no export of raw bodies outside the bucket.

mike-dev: I filed ticket INF-4722 with justification + TTL = 1h capture + 7d retention. tagging maria-security and kate-sre.

adele-eng: will need temporary S3 access to pull the single file after capture — request in the ticket.

audit-bot: Note: S3 object events will be logged and access will require mfa.

maria-security: I'll approve the process but will only grant read for the names on the ticket for 2 hours after capture. After that, we rotate the org salt and delete objects older than 7d. Please ensure the code uses KMS decrypt at runtime, not storing the salt in plaintext.

mike-dev: thanks. we'll implement hashing + hmac in the capture pipeline. ping @adele-eng and @kate-sre when ready to flip the flag.

adele-eng: will stand by. :+1:

maria-security: also create a short postmortem note in the ticket summarizing what was captured and confirm deletion when done.

mike-dev: will do, closing loop once capture complete.
